adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts the mapping of created integration results changes `credentialId` from `isCalendarType ? evt.destinationCalendar?.credentialId : result.credentialId` to `isCalendarType ? result.credentialId : undefined`. This visibly drops `credentialId` for non-calendar integrations (where `isCalendarType` is false), whereas previously non-calendar (e.g., video) references would keep `result.credentialId`. If booking references rely on `credentialId` to later update/delete the video integration, this change would break that resolution path for single-host video bookings.
